text: I'm sorry to bother you this late, I expect you've got children far worse off than ours. My granddaughter is 2 and she's at 37.9. She's got a pink blotchy rash on her back and when I did the glass test on that it went white, so I wasn't too worried. But on her shins there are some little dark red pinprick spots as well and when I pressed the glass on those they stayed exactly the same, I could see them clear through it. I did check her neck because I know they ask about that, and she can look right down at her toes with no fuss at all. I don't want to waste anyone's time but I thought I'd better ask
